description: npm dependencies of OpenRailwayMap-vector, installed with `npm ci`. Build-time: `yaml` and `chroma-js` for the generator scripts in import/, proxy/js/ and api/. In the browser: the MapLibre style spec for proxy/js/overlay.mjs, at the version MapLibre GL JS 6.9.1 is built with, which the proxy image serves from js/node_modules.
